name: week
title: Lending desk week
subtitle: Arrears, maturities and everything waiting on a decision.

sections.title: Arrears
sections.sql: select code,borrower,status,balance_cents,arrears_cents,oldest_unpaid_on,days_in_arrears,last_payment_on,manager from v_arrears order by days_in_arrears desc

sections.title: Maturing within 90 days
sections.sql: select code,borrower,loan_type,maturity_on,days_to_maturity,balance_cents,manager from v_maturities order by maturity_on

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select code,issue,due_on,detail from v_attention order by due_on,code

name: book
title: Loan book
subtitle: Balances, rates and LVR across every live loan.

sections.title: By status
sections.sql: select status,count(*)::int loans,sum(limit_cents)::bigint limit_cents,sum(balance_cents)::bigint balance_cents from v_loans group by status order by status

sections.title: Live loans
sections.sql: select code,borrower,loan_type,limit_cents,balance_cents,rate_bps,committed_lvr_bps,current_lvr_bps,max_lvr_bps,maturity_on from v_loans where status in ('approved','settled','default') order by code

sections.title: Investor funding
sections.sql: select code,borrower,drawn_cents,allocated_cents,unfunded_cents,investors from v_investor_funding order by unfunded_cents desc
sections.note: Unfunded is the part drawn beyond what investors have taken up.

sections.title: Evidence gaps
sections.sql: select code,rule,issue,subject from v_compliance order by rule,code
sections.note: Record checks against the rules in docs/compliance.md. Not legal advice and not a compliance certificate.

sections.title: Securities
sections.sql: select code,loan,address,market_value_cents,complete_value_cents,valued_on,age_days,valuer,valuer_independent,insurance_expires_on from v_valuations order by valued_on

sections.title: Open loan conditions
sections.sql: select code,loan,borrower,title,owner,due_on,days_overdue from v_conditions order by due_on
